purpose: CA-105 deterministic lifecycle/revision edge matrix. Research-only specification fixtures; not a production runtime test.
orderingRule: Sort by effectiveSession, then semantic stage order, never by ingestion order.
Revisions replace the referenced version only from their own knownAt forward for point-in-time replay.
Different semantic stages on the same session remain separate records even when actionFamilyId is shared.
Price factors, share-unit factors and supply-denominator steps are independently idempotent; no stage may apply another stage's transform by implication.

expected: Keep two semantic records.
REGISTERED_ISSUED_SHARES and EXCHANGE_LISTED_SHARES may both step on the same session only because each own stage is proven.
No double price adjustment and no historical raw-volume rescaling.
Replay as of 2026-01-07 sees v1 schedule.
Replay as of 2026-01-09 sees v2 schedule.
No supply step occurs on 2026-01-10 after v2 supersedes v1 before effectiveness.
Point-in-time replay as of 2026-01-12 uses v1.
Ex-post mechanics may use v2 for audit.
v2 must not silently rewrite a 2026-01-12 decision-time feature.
No denominator step on 2026-02-02.
Historical replay before cancellation may know a planned event but must not treat it as realized supply.
ANNOUNCED/PENDING and REALIZED supply stay separate.
Apply unit-continuity transform only in the continuity semantic space.
Apply denominator step only to the declared turnover space.
Do not multiply raw execution volume and then also denominator-normalize as if these were one transform.
Resolve to quality CONFLICT, not latest-wins.
Normalized turnover is UNKNOWN until semantic/source conflict is resolved.
Raw factual share volume remains usable if its own provenance is valid.
Registered and listed/tradable denominators may differ between stages.
The 2025-09-22 registration must not force the listed/tradable denominator to step early.
A tradable supply event can precede final registered-share change.
Do not collapse payment-certificate listing and common-share registration into one date.
Exact exchange-listed/tradable denominator remains PARTIAL_CONFLICT when private-placement treatment is unresolved.

failClosedRules: Conflicting denominator semantics => normalized feature UNKNOWN.
No event is equivalent to NO_EVENT only when source coverage is complete.
Cancellation/revision must preserve prior versions for replay rather than deleting history.
conclusion: CA-105 lifecycle edge contract frozen; executable implementation remains future research engineering only.
